obligations.claim: Orientation coherence conditions admissible knot-class selection (T) but is not independently sufficient for closure stability.

must_establish.formal_need: Define C_orient in a way that does not presuppose closure topology.
Define a topological metric (e.g., braid index) to categorize observed closures.
Show that Var(T | C_orient > 0.8) < Var(T | C_orient approx 0).

must_establish.requirement: Stability arises from Principle 2.X, not orientation.
must_establish.formal_need: Show that closure survival S_closure is highly correlated with R_support but poorly correlated with C_orient once T is fixed.
Verify that specific knot-classes T_k only emerge in compatible orientation regimes.

null.statement: Orientation coherence has no independent effect on knot-class selection or admissible topology T.

alternative.statement: Orientation coherence narrows the set of admissible knot-classes T.

required_form.support_condition: Orientation coherence significantly shifts the modal T_class.
required_form.failure_condition: T_class distribution is invariant to orientation structure.

support.condition: Orientation coherence significantly and predictably narrows the distribution of knot-classes.

downgrade.condition: Orientation effect on T is weak or easily overridden by high residue pressure.

falsify.condition: Topological selection is independent of orientation coherence.

if_supported: OPEN_BRIDGE_001 may be promoted to SUPPORTED.
Triadic closure TC_asym may exit REVIEW_LOCK into T-class specific promotion.
if_falsified: Orientation is retired as a structural selector.
Knot-class selection must be rerouted to pure residue-admissibility dynamics.
